title: Explorer action
responsibility: Renders a button or real navigation link with optional icons.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.href
inputs.description: Optional address. Nonempty and enabled renders an anchor; otherwise a button. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.onclick
inputs.description: Optional handler. For links, only plain clicks are intercepted; other clicks remain native. Buttons invoke it directly if supplied. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.disabled
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True renders a disabled button even when href exists.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.tone
inputs.description: Optional gold or plain styling, default gold.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.icon
inputs.description: Optional trailing icon. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.lead
inputs.description: Optional leading icon. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

inputs.name: HarnessAction.label
inputs.description: Optional fuller accessible name. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), not the literal string.

outputs.name: HarnessAction
outputs.description: Styled action with leading/trailing icons at size 18. Complete caller content wraps within the available width. Buttons have type button. Handler failures are not caught. States: trailing-icon: The action shows its icon after the text without a leading icon. long: The complete long action label wraps within the available control width. focused: The action retains its visible keyboard-focus treatment.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Errors from supplied onclick, children callbacks or snippets propagate when invoked; this component does not provide an error boundary.
